subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan SKILL.md detection outside configured skill roots, and should that detection run only in an explicit skills check or Doctor path?
rationale: The missing diagnostic is source-reproducible, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior that code inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add a bounded orphan detector to skills check or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and actionable remediation wording.

options.title: Startup Warning Too
options.body: Also warn during startup, accepting extra runtime scanning and operator-visible noise for faster discovery.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add a bounded orphan detector to skills check or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and actionable remediation wording.

likelyOwner.reason: This product choice crosses the original skills CLI, bundled skill-creator, and workspace audit surfaces where this handle has the strongest feature-history trail.
